limitations: AI response is explicitly prerecorded local fixture, identical for options; no inference, network, credentials or AI backend. Original result-selection/replace/insert/discard UI handlers retained.

Original advanced editor/headless source is fixed. Original default rich-text document retained; remote image/Tweet blocks replaced by explicit unavailable text. No uploads/file drop/cloud saving. Draft status says Saved in memory.

Remote Tweet renderer replaced by explicit boundary text, image/Youtube embeds cannot fetch/play under unchanged CSP. Selected text-writing workflow is complete, not a claim of full remote media integration.

Original styling/Tailwind tokens and ProseMirror CSS compiled; external/binary fonts omitted, system fallbacks used including KaTeX CSS without font files. No native font/math/pixel/drag-layout verification.
Controlled JSDOM Range/DOM geometry and observer fixtures, not native selection/IME/pointer rendering QA. Original callbacks exercised in production bundles.
Natural complete-JS-statement chunks each independently parse and run, no eval/Function wrappers or binary/base64 payload. Host only uses existing ordered-text loader.

199 positive-emitted package paths, including nested package identities; 3 separate compiled-CSS contributions. Missing standalone old Radix/scroll-bar licenses use clearly identified MIT supplements from explicit official npm declarations, not fabricated historical LICENSE files.
TipTap 2.11.2 and ProseMirror versions pinned to original pnpm lock; preserves original drag-handle dependency on __serializeForClipboard. No incompatible latest-package substitution.
